scopeOfChanges.description: Mechanical path-alias unification across 11 source files plus admin/media.astro pagination migration and a new component-standards.md design-system document.

additionalChanges.change: Inline `<a>` pagination chain replaced with Starwind `<Pagination>` component.
New 140-line document covering Fulldev priority components, Starwind exclusive components, deprecated Starwind components, and a decision flow for new code.

reviewerNotes.logic: All 30 alias replacements are mechanical (`@components/` -> `@/components/`) with no logic change. Pagination refactor swaps inline `<a>` chain for the existing Starwind `<Pagination>` component while preserving query-string and total-page behavior. No control flow, error handling, or state changes were introduced.
reviewerNotes.security: Path-alias string replacement has no security surface. The Pagination component is rendered with HTML-attribute interpolation matching the previous inline markup; no new user input is consumed and no untrusted data crosses a new trust boundary.
reviewerNotes.performance: No new hot-path code introduced. Replacing inline `<a>` chain with a parameterized component removes duplication. No N+1, blocking, or memory issues present.

recommendations: Mechanical refactor + doc creation — no code-quality issues identified.
Increment is clean and ready for closure.
notes: All 14 tasks marked completed in tasks.md.
All 9 acceptance criteria checked in spec.md.
Post-fix verification: `grep -rn "@components/" src/pages/ src/components/islands/` returns 0 results; `grep -rn "@/components/" ... | wc -l` returns 161.
component-standards.md is 140 lines and contains all required sections (Fulldev priority, Starwind exclusive, deprecated, decision flow).
